annotations.title: Bridge quote (XRP <-> Bitcoin, BNB Chain, Base)

description: FREE. Get a live, firm quote to move funds both ways between native XRP on the XRP Ledger and BTC on Bitcoin, BNB, USDT or USDC on BNB Chain (bsc), or USDC or ETH on Base (12 live routes). Returns quote_id, exact payment instructions (amount, asset, network, pay_to, expiry), the N9T2 fee (1.45 XRP equivalent) and the estimated destination amount. Creating a quote moves no funds. Optional source_amount up to 1000 USDC / 1500 XRP / 0.5 ETH / 1.5 BNB / 1000 USDT / 0.02 BTC; larger transfers go to the OTC desk (boss@n9t2.com). Next: customer approves and pays in their own wallet, then call n9t2_bridge_submit_payment.

destination_address.description: Customer-controlled destination wallet: r... classic address for xrpl, bc1.../3.../1... for bitcoin, 0x... for bsc or base.
destination_address.title: Destination Address

destination_asset.description: Asset delivered: XRP on xrpl; BTC on bitcoin; BNB, USDT or USDC on bsc; USDC or ETH on base.
destination_asset.title: Destination Asset

destination_chain.description: Chain that receives the funds; must differ from source_chain, and one of the two must be xrpl.
destination_chain.title: Destination Chain

source_amount.description: Optional amount to bridge in the source asset as a decimal string, e.g. '250'. The N9T2 fee is added on top. Self-serve cap: 1000 USDC, 1500 XRP, 0.5 ETH, 1.5 BNB, 1000 USDT or 0.02 BTC. Omit for the live route minimum.
source_amount.title: Source Amount

source_asset.description: Asset the customer pays with: XRP on xrpl; BTC on bitcoin; BNB, USDT or USDC on bsc; USDC or ETH on base.
source_asset.title: Source Asset

source_chain.description: Chain the customer pays from: xrpl (XRP Ledger), bitcoin, bsc (BNB Chain) or base. Every route has xrpl on one side.
source_chain.title: Source Chain
